title: Ray of Hope? China and the Rise of Solar Energy
venue: Revise & Resubmit, Quarterly Journal of Economics; NBER Working Paper No. 34893
abstract: Do industrial policies that promote clean energy offer a "ray of hope", increasing a country's growth and welfare, whilst simultaneously reducing carbon emissions? We study the impact of Chinese solar subsidies whose implementation by city-regions went alongside massive expansion of the sector and a dramatic fall in global solar prices. We construct new city and firm panel data on solar policies, patenting and output. Using synthetic-difference-in-differences 2004-2020, we find production and innovation subsidies were more effective than demand-side (installation) subsidies in generating large and persistent increases in local innovation, net entry, production and exports. Demand policies did, however, reduce local pollution. To examine aggregate effects, we build and structurally estimate a quantitative spatial model with endogenous innovation and heterogeneous productivity across firms and cities, which accounts for business stealing and knowledge spillovers. Counterfactual analysis shows that: (i) local effects remain substantial at the macro level explaining 40%-50% of the aggregate changes in solar innovation, prices and revenues; (ii) social benefits to Chinese citizens exceed subsidy costs by 65% (and double this when environmental benefits are included); and (iii) although all subsidy types increase welfare, innovation subsidies are the most cost-effective.
abstract_zh: 促进清洁能源的产业政策是否提供了一线“希望之光”（“ray of hope”），在减少碳排放的同时促进一个国家的增长和福利？我们研究了中国太阳能补贴的影响，这些补贴由各城市地区实施，并伴随着该行业的大规模扩张以及全球太阳能价格的急剧下降。我们构建了关于太阳能政策、专利和产出的新的城市与企业面板数据。利用2004至2020年的合成双重差分法（synthetic difference-in-differences），我们发现，生产和创新补贴在促进地方创新、净进入、生产和出口方面，比需求侧（安装）补贴更为有效，并且带来了规模大、持续时间长的增长。然而，需求政策确实降低了当地的污染。为考察总体效应，我们构建并结构性估计了一个定量空间模型，该模型内生化了创新，并纳入了企业和城市之间的异质性生产率，同时考虑了业务抢占效应（business stealing）和知识溢出效应。反事实分析表明：（i）局部效应在宏观层面依然显著，解释了太阳能创新、价格和收入总体变化的40%至50%；（ii）中国公民获得的社会收益超过补贴成本65%（若纳入环境收益，则该比例翻倍）；（iii）尽管所有补贴类型都能提高福利，但创新补贴是成本效益最高的。

title: Trading Trash on Tricycles
abstract: Developing megacities face severe congestion externalities but lack the fiscal and enforcement capacity for textbook regulation. In its absence, unregulated private provision emerges across services like waste, sanitation, water, and transport. This thesis explores whether limited, feasible regulation can leverage these informal markets to deliver public services at scale, focusing on trash collection in Accra, Ghana. Using novel data, we document an imperfect but functioning market: households pay informal tricycle collectors for door-to-door service, yet prices remain too high for universal access, and final disposal occurs largely at illegal dumpsites. We identify a single feasible lever – subsidies for formal, environmentally controlled disposal – and evaluate it using a new structural model of urban waste collection and disposal. To estimate the model, we combine survey experiments eliciting household demand, a custom app recording transactions and tricycle routes, and a field experiment randomising dumping fees. Counterfactual results show that a modest subsidy achieves roughly 80% of the efficient outcome, substantially reducing environmental damages while generating larger welfare gains at lower cost than planned infrastructure expansion. These findings demonstrate that even in very low-capacity environments, limited price-based regulation can align informal private initiative with social objectives. The chapters included in this thesis introduce the question and background, provide details of the data collection exercises, a description of Accra’s waste market, the estimation of households’ demand for waste collection using survey experiments, the estimation of a broader quantitative model of waste collection, transport, and disposal, and finally, includes results from a complementary field experiment that tests the policy solutions identified through the quantitative model.
abstract_zh: 发展中的超大城市面临严重的拥堵外部性，但缺乏教科书式监管所需的财政和执法能力。在缺乏监管的情况下，垃圾收运、环卫、供水和交通等服务领域出现了非正规的私人供给。本论文探讨有限但可行的监管能否利用这些非正规市场，大规模地提供公共服务，研究聚焦于加纳阿克拉的垃圾收运。利用新的数据，我们记录了一个不完善但运转良好的市场：居民向非正规的三轮车收运者支付费用，以获得上门服务，但价格仍然过高，无法实现普遍覆盖，且最终处置大多在非法垃圾堆放点进行。我们识别出一个唯一可行的政策杠杆——为正规的、环境可控的处置提供补贴——并利用一个关于城市垃圾收运与处置的新结构模型对其进行评估。为估计该模型，我们结合了用于获取居民需求的调查实验、记录交易和三轮车路线的定制应用程序，以及随机设定倾倒费的田野实验。反事实结果表明，适度的补贴可实现约80%的有效率结果，在大幅减少环境损害的同时，以低于计划性基础设施扩建的成本带来更大的福利收益。这些发现表明，即使在能力非常薄弱的环境中，有限的价格型监管也能使非正规的私人积极性与社会目标相一致。本论文各章节介绍了研究问题与背景、数据收集工作的细节、阿克拉垃圾市场的描述、利用调查实验估计居民对垃圾收运的需求、对更广泛的垃圾收运、运输与处置定量模型的估计，最后包括一项补充性田野实验的结果，该实验检验了定量模型所识别出的政策方案。
